claims.claim: Eurogamer reports that, in the Game Informer feature, the studio said there are over 170 animal species in the world, including 60 different birds and more than 30 land mammals.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer, 30 Sep 2026, final paragraph. Opened 5 Oct 2026.

claims.claim: Rockstar's official site describes Grassrivers as a primordial expanse where the gators may be the most famous attraction but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves.
claims.evidence: rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/grassrivers, region description, read from the page source on 5 Oct 2026. Marketing copy: it describes the place, not a game mechanic.
claims.quote: The gators may be the most famous attraction, but there are far deadlier predators and weirder discoveries among the mangroves.

claims.claim: One of the official Grassrivers screenshots on Rockstar's site is described, in its own image description, as a helicopter and two police cars chasing a pick-up truck through a swamp with alligators, with an airboat in the background.
claims.evidence: rockstargames.com/VI/only-in-leonida/grassrivers, alt text of image Grassrivers_04, read from the page source on 5 Oct 2026. It is a still image: it shows the scene, it does not say animals react to the chase.
claims.quote: A helicopter and two police cars chase a pick-up truck through a swamp with alligators in the Grassrivers.

sources.title: GTA 6 completely "re-engineered" Rockstar's weather systems to "achieve a sense of scale we haven't felt before," adding hurricanes, rainbows and heavy rain
GTA 6 will simulate hurricanes, rainbows and persistent, dynamic clouds, among other efforts to make you stop doing crime and become a weather nerd
Grand Theft Auto VI: Only in Leonida: Grassrivers (official site)
sources.note: Found by web search on 5 Oct 2026 and opened the same day. Not from a feed. The page is rendered by script; the text was read from the page source.
